Container.Name: Tinkerex
Container.Overview: A self-hosted library for a maker's files (3D models, CAD, laser, PDFs, images) with thumbnails, projects, inventory and a Tools gallery. Point it at a share that holds your files; it indexes them every 15 minutes and on demand, uploads land in the share as plain files, and the first account you create becomes the owner. Both paths below must be writable by uid 1000 (see the template's comment). Full reference: docs/INSTALL.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port the web app is reached on.

Config.Name: App data (database and thumbnails)
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite databases and the thumbnails. Create it first and make it writable by uid 1000: chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/tinkerex

Config.Name: Library (your files)
Config.Description: The share that holds your files. Indexed every 15 minutes and on the Rescan button; uploads and deletions happen inside it (deleted files move to its .trash folder). Must be writable by uid 1000; Unraid's default share permissions allow it.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
Config.Description: Signs sessions. Generate once with: openssl rand -hex 64. Keep it; changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: APP_HOST
Config.Description: The host name or IP people type to reach this server, with no scheme (e.g. 192.168.1.20 or maker.example.net). Links in email point at it.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_BACKEND
Config.Description: Fixed for this template: the library is the share mounted at /library.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_PATH
Config.Description: Fixed for this template: where the library share is mounted inside the container.

Config.Name: RAILS_MAX_THREADS
Config.Description: Web server threads and the database pool.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Leave empty (closed): the first account you create is the owner and sign-ups close after it. 'open' is refused on this backend, because every account would see the same share; add accounts from the console instead (docs/INSTALL.md section 4).

Config.Name: SMTP_ADDRESS
Config.Description: SMTP host for confirmation and password-reset mail. Empty means no mail; the first account needs none.

Config.Name: SMTP_USER_NAME
Config.Description: SMTP user, if the relay needs authentication.

Config.Name: MAIL_FROM
Config.Description: Sender address for mail; defaults to no-reply at APP_HOST.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_TRASH_DAYS
Config.Description: Days a deleted file stays in the share's .trash folder before the daily purge; 0 keeps everything forever.
